title: Frontend / CLI / MCP / ACP / A2A / SSH / Hosted Surface Deep Assessment Audit v1

surfaces.name: Desktop Cockpit Frontend
surfaces.authentication_model: local-only, pywebview bridge, WebSocket token-gated, localhost-only
surfaces.schema_boundary: bridge_protocol.py BridgeMessage; projection.py PROJECTION_SCHEMA_PATH; intents.py ALLOWED_INTENTS
surfaces.content_light_boundary: SHA256 hashes in projection; no raw file content in WebSocket stream; projection widgets content-light
surfaces.telemetry_evidence_behavior: product_telemetry_disabled degrades adaptive recommendations and UX optimization; operational observability (health checks, permission probes, receipt records) preserved; enterprise evidence continuity mandatory
surfaces.current_tests_evidence: 30+ test files in tests/desktop/; tests/desktop/test_projection.py, test_projection_contract.py, test_bridge_protocol.py, etc.
surfaces.known_gaps: No GitHub trust-spine indicators in cockpit; no Postgres unavailable indicator; no hosted-mode indicators; 6 telemetry/evidence state indicators recommended but not implemented

surfaces.name: CLI Entrypoint (rig-relay)
surfaces.authentication_model: local user context; OS keychain for API keys
surfaces.authorization_model: arg-parsed commands; dry-run by default for mutations
surfaces.schema_boundary: argparse; JSON output mode available via doctor --json
surfaces.content_light_boundary: JSON output uses content-light hashing; telemetry bundles use SHA256
surfaces.telemetry_evidence_behavior: CLI commands emit receipts; checkout tool produces checkpoint artifacts; telemetry bundles are content-light
surfaces.current_tests_evidence: tests/cli/; test_cli_entrypoint.py, test_doctor.py; 1000+ lines of demo_commands.py for seed/test data
surfaces.known_gaps: No structured JSONL output mode for most commands; no unified command taxonomy; scripts/ vs rig_relay/cli/ split creates two CLIs; no dry-run-by-default for scripts

surfaces.name: Scripts CLI (scripts/rig_*.py)
surfaces.authentication_model: per-script; some use env vars, some use keychain, some require GitHub App auth
surfaces.authorization_model: per-script; no unified policy engine integration in most scripts
surfaces.schema_boundary: per-script; some produce schema-validated JSON artifacts
surfaces.content_light_boundary: per-script; quality varies; some scripts produce content-light artifacts, others may not
surfaces.telemetry_evidence_behavior: per-script; most produce .build/ artifacts; telemetry bundle scripts exist
surfaces.known_gaps: 121 scripts with no unified taxonomy, no consistent dry-run default, no consistent schema, no consistent auth; scripts bypass intent gating; scripts can mutate without cockpit approval

surfaces.name: MCP Server (JSON-RPC)
surfaces.current_maturity: implemented (v1 server, models, auth metadata, refusal adapter)
surfaces.user_segment_served: developers, AI tools (Antigravity, Claude Desktop, Cursor)
surfaces.authentication_model: local stdio transport (default); Streamable HTTP deferred; per-user authorization model defined but not yet integrated with identity system; bearer/OAuth supported in metadata but not implemented
surfaces.authorization_model: 5-tier tool model (0=read_only, 1=analysis, 2=validation, 3=patch_proposal, 4=mutation, 5=git_release); tiers 4+ require authorization_receipt; tier 5 denied by default; per-user authorization (MCPPerUserAuthorization) defined but not enforced; content-light tool provenance hashes (compute_tool_provenance_hash)
surfaces.schema_boundary: rig.relay.mcp.refusal.v1, rig.relay.mcp.tool_call_receipt.v1; 16 tools across 5 tiers; 6 resources; 3 prompts
surfaces.content_light_boundary: provenance hashes (name+description+input_schema+server_identity); content_light: true in all responses; request_hash/response_hash in receipts
surfaces.telemetry_evidence_behavior: refusal envelopes and tool-call receipts are evidence artifacts; refusal reasoning is traceable; product telemetry integration not yet wired
surfaces.current_tests_evidence: tests/protocols/mcp/ (5 test files); tests/tools/test_mcp.py, test_mcp_sampling.py; tests/stubs/fake_mcp_registry.py; tests/integration/test_integration_acp_mcp_release_gate.py
surfaces.known_gaps: No real tool dispatch for most MCP tools (stub implementations); no MCP roots enforcement; no tool descriptor integrity checking at runtime; per-user authorization not enforced; no transport security beyond local stdio; tier-4 and tier-5 tools blocked but refusal is advisory (no cryptographic enforcement); tool descriptor rug-pull detection exists but not integrated into request flow

surfaces.name: ACP Agent
surfaces.current_maturity: partial (models implemented, agent class implemented, no transport server, entrypoint delegates to legacy)
surfaces.user_segment_served: developers using editors (Zed, JetBrains, VS Code via sidecar)
surfaces.authentication_model: ACP session model defined; no ACP transport authentication implemented; IDE sidecar uses local stdio IPC
surfaces.authorization_model: ACPEditProposal flows through governance (never direct write); ACPPermissionRequest returns ACPPermissionResponse with decision; ACPTerminalOutput uses output_sha256 (content-light)
surfaces.schema_boundary: rig.relay.acp.capability_profile.v1, rig.relay.acp.session_receipt.v1, rig.relay.acp.refusal.v1, rig.relay.acp.auth_state.v1; ACP models: ACPSessionInfo, ACPProgressEvent, ACPEditProposal, ACPEditResult, ACPPermissionRequest, ACPPermissionResponse, ACPTerminalOutput, ACPPlan
surfaces.content_light_boundary: touched_path_hashes (not paths); diff_sha256; output_sha256; content_light: true in ACP capability profile
surfaces.telemetry_evidence_behavior: session receipts; edit proposal receipts; permission request/response receipts; progress events traceable
surfaces.known_gaps: No ACP transport server implementation; entrypoint delegates to legacy vibe.*; no session lifecycle persistence; no resume support (authenticate_supported=false, resume_supported=false); no integration with mission system; no integration with coordination store; ACPEditProposal doesn't produce patch_proposal artifacts; ACPTerminalOutput doesn't use RuntimeSupervisor

surfaces.name: A2A Agent-to-Agent Delegation
surfaces.current_maturity: partial (schemas exist, basic implementation, no transport, no federation)
surfaces.authentication_model: Agent Card identity hash defined; no transport authentication; no remote agent verification
surfaces.authorization_model: agent_capability cards define capabilities; trust_tier concept planned but not implemented; delegation receipt model exists
surfaces.content_light_boundary: content_light: true in agent cards; local_only: true; remote_federation_supported: false
surfaces.telemetry_evidence_behavior: task lifecycle events; delegation receipts; Agent Card attestation artifacts
surfaces.known_gaps: No A2A transport server; no agent discovery mechanism; no capability advertisement; Agent Cards exist in schema but not in implementation; no trust tier enforcement; no timeout/cancellation/budget for delegated tasks; no cross-agent evidence correlation; no malicious Agent Card detection; local_only: true means federation not built

surfaces.name: IDE Sidecar (VSCodium Extension)
surfaces.current_maturity: implemented (IPC protocol, 42 capabilities, capability broker, sidecar protocol)
surfaces.authentication_model: local stdio IPC; workspace trust concept; no network transport
surfaces.authorization_model: 5 default_policy tiers: allow, allow_if_workspace_trusted, ask_once_per_session, always_ask, deny; 42 capabilities with per-capability risk and mutates classification
surfaces.schema_boundary: rig.ide.capability_manifest.v1 (42 capabilities); rig.ide.capability_receipt.v1; rig.ide.sidecar.message.v1 (7 message types)
surfaces.content_light_boundary: content-light capability receipts; workspace_snapshot uses SHA256 for file hashes; no raw file content in IPC
surfaces.telemetry_evidence_behavior: capability receipts per capability invocation; approval/denial receipts; workspace trust audit events
surfaces.known_gaps: Sidecar runs ACP agent internally but ACP transport not fully integrated; capability manifest is single canonical JSON but capability changes are not diffed as evidence; no capability drift detection; IDE extension is TypeScript thin host; no JetBrains/Zed integration yet (capability manifest marks them as planned)

surfaces.name: WebSocket Projection Server
surfaces.authentication_model: token-gated; localhost-only (127.0.0.1); max 10 connections; auth timeout 5s
surfaces.authorization_model: per-message-type rate limiting; 30 message types with schema validation; intent messages delegated to desktop/intents.py
surfaces.schema_boundary: message_type-specific JSON schemas; structured error codes; structured close codes
surfaces.content_light_boundary: projection is content-light by design (SHA256 hashes, artifact refs, no raw content); chat messages may contain content but are not projected externally
surfaces.telemetry_evidence_behavior: connection lifecycle events; message rate metrics; auth events; projection refresh events
surfaces.known_gaps: No transport-level encryption (localhost-only, but still plain WS); no mutual TLS for non-localhost deployment; no connection attestation; rate limiting is local-memory-only

surfaces.name: Desktop Bridge Server (HTTPS/WSS)
surfaces.authentication_model: local HTTPS with self-signed cert; localhost-only; pywebview window isolation
surfaces.authorization_model: bidirectional bridge protocol with message priority (LOW/NORMAL/HIGH/CRITICAL); sequence tracking; dedup; state machine; flow control
surfaces.content_light_boundary: projection payloads content-light; bridge messages use SHA256 for correlation; no raw content in telemetry
surfaces.telemetry_evidence_behavior: lifecycle trace (lifecycle_artifact.py); bridge diagnostics; bridge_lifecycle_trace; correlation events
surfaces.current_tests_evidence: tests/desktop/test_bridge_protocol.py, test_bridge_runtime_state.py, test_bridge_state_machine.py, test_bridge_diagnostics.py, test_bridge_refusals.py, test_bridge_lifecycle_trace.py, test_bridge_security.py, test_desktop_bridge_state_machine.py, test_bridge_refusal_persistence.py, test_bridge_refusal_trace_correlation.py, test_bridge_probe.py
surfaces.known_gaps: pywebview is a desktop dependency that may limit cross-platform deployment; CSP/XSS posture relies on pywebview's web engine; no hosted/remote bridge capability

surfaces.name: Static Documentation Site
surfaces.user_segment_served: public (open-source community, procurement reviewers, enterprise evaluators)
surfaces.authorization_model: public/private split; content-light scan before public pages generation; no raw evidence, secrets, or private repo content in public pages
surfaces.schema_boundary: generated from docs/json/ artifacts; rendered via Jinja2 templates; served via GitHub Pages
surfaces.content_light_boundary: public pages must never contain raw alerts, private repo content, agent prompts, telemetry, rate-limit budgets, token scopes, or secret-bearing data; all content-derived data uses SHA256
surfaces.telemetry_evidence_behavior: render metadata (timestamps, commit hash, schema versions); no user telemetry in static site
surfaces.current_tests_evidence: tests/docs/; tests/governance/test_static_site_convergence.py; CI pages.yml deploys on push to main
surfaces.known_gaps: No automated public/private split enforcement before deploy; no stale page detection in CI; no OG metadata validation; no content-light scan before pages deployment

surfaces.name: SSH Remote Execution Boundary
surfaces.user_segment_served: enterprise admin, remote development, hosted worker fleet
surfaces.known_gaps: No SSH surface exists anywhere in Rig Relay. No remote execution model. No SSH key management. No command allowlisting. No session recording. No remote evidence collection. RuntimeSupervisor is local-only. Subprocess execution has no remote variant.

surfaces.name: Hosted/Team Deployment Mode
surfaces.current_maturity: partial (fleet controller exists for subprocess-based multi-instance; headless server exists; no true multi-tenant hosted mode)
surfaces.authentication_model: tenant concept exists (TenantRegistry, tenant-scoped event dispatch); no hosted API; no user/session model for hosted
surfaces.authorization_model: TenantPermissionEvaluator with 6 permission levels; per-tenant event isolation; cross-tenant events restricted
surfaces.schema_boundary: tenant topology projection; fleet health models; no hosted API schema
surfaces.content_light_boundary: tenant topology projections are read_side_only and content-light
surfaces.telemetry_evidence_behavior: tenant-scoped event dispatch; fleet health projections; no hosted telemetry/evidence merge yet
surfaces.known_gaps: No hosted API airlock. No WebSocket auth for remote clients. No multi-user session model. No SSO/SCIM integration. No data residency controls. No hosted GitHub integration. No billing/subscription model. No remote contribution policy enforcement for hosted mode. Fleet controller uses subprocess spawn — not true hosted multi-tenancy. Postgres adapter not yet implemented.

surfaces.name: Local Inference Airlock
surfaces.authentication_model: local file-based config; no auth on airlock itself
surfaces.authorization_model: capability gate (local_inference_probe); content-light config (URL only, no API keys)
surfaces.content_light_boundary: endpoint URL and metadata only; never stores API keys
surfaces.known_gaps: Airlock is local-inference-specific, not a general API airlock; no hosted API airlock exists; no rate limiting on airlock; no multi-endpoint airlock federation

surfaces.name: Telemetry Export Bundles
surfaces.authentication_model: opt-in only; operator-initiated export via CLI scripts; API keys and provider secrets stripped before bundling
surfaces.authorization_model: local user confirmation; enterprise admin consent for fleet-wide exports; opt-out fully respected (no telemetry bundled if telemetry is disabled)
surfaces.schema_boundary: rig.relay.telemetry.bundle_manifest.v1; rig.relay.telemetry.bundle_envelope.v1; content-light SHA256 hashes used for all content-derived data; bundle includes manifest with schema version, source session IDs, and redaction scan result
surfaces.content_light_boundary: all content-derived data uses SHA256 hashes; raw file contents, secrets, tokens, and private code are never included; redaction scan runs before bundle finalization; bundle manifest lists what was excluded and why
surfaces.telemetry_evidence_behavior: telemetry bundles are structured evidence artifacts themselves; bundle creation emits bundle_lifecycle events; contribution pipeline emits bundle_submission events; enterprise audit records bundle exports; observability.jsonl sessions are the canonical source
surfaces.known_gaps: No automated redaction audit before export (manual review currently required); no hosted contribution pipeline (bundles exported locally only); no enterprise admin controls over export schedule (no cron/automated export); no bundle size limits enforced before creation; no incremental/differential bundle support (full bundle only); no bundle encryption at rest; no bundle recipient verification in contribution pipeline; no signed bundle integrity verification (SHA256 only, no cryptographic signature)

content_light.redaction_note: This audit contains no raw tokens, secrets, private repository contents, or source code. All content-derived references use descriptive identifiers.
